content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?FOX 13's Paul Dellegatto's PostOnline status indicatorActiveFOX 13's Paul Dellegatto Verified accountMarch 30 at 12:31 AM · Shared with PublicEl Niño is likely to develop this summer and last to at least the end of 2026. This is a big deal for Florida and the southeast. If we complete the transition from La Nina to El Nino this summer, we can expect an increase in not only summer thunderstorms, but also above average rainfall through the winter. While the additional rain will obviously be welcome, there will be an increased threat for severe weather (tornadoes) this winter.
